title: OEM warehouse and products
completionMessage: The products, the stock of {products.vehicle.productName} at {mu.name} and the new warehouse, FIFO and product-flag requirements are shown. The spec does not define them yet.

oem-products-list.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the list columns and the status filter values for the products list cannot be shown. The columns shown are Vehicle, Variant, Colour and Status.

oem-product-detail.proposedAction: Look at the product detail and the dashboard
oem-product-detail.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the week, month and year options and the report content (per-model rollup, stock by manufacturing unit and the price matrix) cannot be shown for {products.vehicle.productName}.

oem-stock-tabs.proposedAction: Look at the OEM stock tabs
oem-stock-tabs.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the names of the nine tabs and the unit and stock filter values cannot be shown. Only stock history and reserved stock are named.

oem-stock-one-product.proposedAction: Click add stock to go to the MU stock

oem-mu-stock.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the warehouse locations cannot be shown. N12 Warehouse Location Master defines bin, rack and zone locations per manufacturing unit.

fifo-issuance.proposedAction: Read the FIFO stock issue requirement
fifo-issuance.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the FIFO stock issue (oldest first) and the stock-by-location report (N13) cannot be shown.
fifo-issuance.performedText: read the FIFO stock issue requirement

spare-form.proposedAction: Look at the spare product form
spare-form.notDefined: Not defined in screen_details.md, so the inventory type flag (N14) and the spare part extended fields (N24) cannot be shown on this form.
spare-form.performedText: looked at the spare product form
